Actor Allu Arjun appears virtually in court over stampede case

Actor Allu Arjun appeared virtually before the Nampally court in connection with a stampede incident. The court was hearing the case related to the Sandhya Theatre stampede. The virtual appearance addresses the court's inquiry into the matter.
